population.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

endpoint.span: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, or coronary revascularization (to assess effects on major cardiovascular events)

treatment_strategy.span: Participants will be randomly assigned to oral atorvastatin (40 mg daily) or matching placebo (1:1 ratio).

follow_up.span: After a median of 5.9 years, a primary cardiovascular event had occurred

absent_reason: analysis_set: The protocol specifies planned intention-to-treat analyses, but no held results source explicitly states the analysis population used for the reported HR.
served_mismatch: The served HR and confidence limits match the results abstract. However, the served intention-to-treat designation is not confirmed for the reported estimate. The source reports an HR, not the RR specified in served_outcome.estimand.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Participants were aged ≥70 years and had no history of clinical cardiovascular disease.
entry_population_matches_question.span: STAREE enrolled people aged ≥70 years from 1583 general practices across Australia with no history of clinical cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia.

notes: The results abstract supplies the estimate and its endpoint definition, which includes coronary revascularization. The protocol and baseline full texts describe a narrower cardiovascular composite without revascularization; their endpoint definitions cannot replace the definition attached to this result. Treatment assignment is supported by the protocol and corroborated by the results abstract. No registry spans were needed.
